review_scope: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5 with per-locale reviewer agents); no native-speaker signoff.

records.key: How cells and nuclei are found in the slide image: the segmenter, which stain it reads, the Cellpose model and diameter, how far a nucleus is grown to make its cell, and whether the graphics card is used.
records.source: How cells and nuclei are found in the slide image: the segmenter, which stain it reads, the Cellpose model and diameter, how far a nucleus is grown to make its cell, and whether the graphics card is used.
records.translation: Comment les cellules et les noyaux sont trouvés dans l’image de la lame : le segmenteur, la coloration qu’il lit, le modèle et le diamètre Cellpose, de combien un noyau est étendu pour former sa cellule et si la carte graphique est utilisée.

records.key: How much of the slide image is segmented and in what pieces: the pyramid level, an optional window, and the tile size and overlap the image is cut into so a whole slide fits in memory.
records.source: How much of the slide image is segmented and in what pieces: the pyramid level, an optional window, and the tile size and overlap the image is cut into so a whole slide fits in memory.
records.translation: Quelle partie de l’image de la lame est segmentée et en quels morceaux : le niveau de pyramide, une fenêtre facultative, ainsi que la taille des tuiles et le chevauchement selon lesquels l’image est découpée pour qu’une lame entière tienne en mémoire.

records.key: How transcripts or bins are counted into the segmented objects: the Visium HD bin size, the minimum Xenium quality value, which objects receive counts, the gene drawn on the overlay, and whether an AnnData file is written.
records.source: How transcripts or bins are counted into the segmented objects: the Visium HD bin size, the minimum Xenium quality value, which objects receive counts, the gene drawn on the overlay, and whether an AnnData file is written.
records.translation: Comment les transcrits ou les bins sont comptés dans les objets segmentés : la taille de bin Visium HD, la valeur de qualité minimale Xenium, les objets qui reçoivent des comptages, le gène tracé sur la superposition et l’écriture ou non d’un fichier AnnData.

records.key: Which genes belong to the pathogen and how many of their transcripts make an object infected. Every object's distance to the nearest infected one is measured from this call.
records.source: Which genes belong to the pathogen and how many of their transcripts make an object infected. Every object's distance to the nearest infected one is measured from this call.
records.translation: Quels gènes appartiennent au pathogène et combien de leurs transcrits font qu’un objet est infecté. La distance de chaque objet à l’objet infecté le plus proche est mesurée à partir de cette détermination.

records.key: Which spatial transcriptomics run is read and where its results go: the Xenium or Visium HD output folder, the platform that wrote it, and either the folder the segmented fields are written to or the masks folder the barcodes are mapped onto. Set these first; every other spatial group assumes they are right.
records.source: Which spatial transcriptomics run is read and where its results go: the Xenium or Visium HD output folder, the platform that wrote it, and either the folder the segmented fields are written to or the masks folder the barcodes are mapped onto. Set these first; every other spatial group assumes they are right.
records.translation: Quelle exécution de transcriptomique spatiale est lue et où vont ses résultats : le dossier de sortie Xenium ou Visium HD, la plateforme qui l’a écrit, et soit le dossier où sont écrits les champs segmentés, soit le dossier de masques sur lequel les codes-barres sont projetés. Réglez-les d’abord ; tous les autres groupes spatiaux supposent qu’ils sont corrects.

records.source: 3D images (*.tif *.tiff *.mrc *.rec *.map)
records.translation: Images 3D (*.tif *.tiff *.mrc *.rec *.map)

records.source: Assign 3D objects

records.key: Choose a positive object ID that the mask can store.
records.source: Choose a positive object ID that the mask can store.
records.translation: Choisissez un ID d’objet positif que le masque peut stocker.

records.key: Choose an object drawn on at least two slices to interpolate.
records.source: Choose an object drawn on at least two slices to interpolate.
records.translation: Choisissez un objet dessiné sur au moins deux coupes pour l’interpoler.

records.key: Choose the X, Y or Z axis for a volume section.
records.source: Choose the X, Y or Z axis for a volume section.
records.translation: Choisissez l’axe X, Y ou Z pour une coupe du volume.

records.key: Download a FIB-SEM volume of a HeLa cell (about 25 MB, EMPIAR-10982, CC0) and open it unsegmented in the 3D mask editor. Cached after the first download.
records.source: Download a FIB-SEM volume of a HeLa cell (about 25 MB, EMPIAR-10982, CC0) and open it unsegmented in the 3D mask editor. Cached after the first download.
records.translation: Télécharge un volume FIB-SEM d’une cellule HeLa (environ 25 Mo, EMPIAR-10982, CC0) et l’ouvre non segmenté dans l’éditeur de masques 3D. Mis en cache après le premier téléchargement.

records.key: FIB-SEM volume, 3D (test data)

records.key: Fill the empty sections between sections where the chosen object is drawn, blending its outline from one to the next.

records.translation: Remplit les coupes vides entre les coupes où l’objet choisi est dessiné, en fondant son contour de l’une à la suivante.

records.key: Give every separate 3D object its own ID: parts of one ID that do not touch in 3D become new objects.
records.source: Give every separate 3D object its own ID: parts of one ID that do not touch in 3D become new objects.
records.translation: Donne à chaque objet 3D distinct son propre ID : les parties d’un ID qui ne se touchent pas en 3D deviennent de nouveaux objets.

records.source: MRC volumes need the optional mrcfile package: pip install "spacr[tem]"
records.translation: Les volumes MRC nécessitent le paquet facultatif mrcfile : pip install "spacr[tem]"

records.key: Open a z-stack or volume (TIFF, OME-TIFF or MRC) and draw 3D masks slice by slice, interpolate between slices and save a 3D label TIFF. The current 2D image and mask stay unchanged.
records.source: Open a z-stack or volume (TIFF, OME-TIFF or MRC) and draw 3D masks slice by slice, interpolate between slices and save a 3D label TIFF. The current 2D image and mask stay unchanged.
records.translation: Ouvre une pile Z ou un volume (TIFF, OME-TIFF ou MRC) et dessine des masques 3D coupe par coupe, interpole entre les coupes et enregistre un TIFF d’étiquettes 3D. L’image 2D et le masque actuels restent inchangés.

records.key: Open the FIB-SEM volume in the 3D mask editor with its mitochondria masks loaded for correction. Corrections are saved in corrected_masks; the published masks stay unchanged.
records.source: Open the FIB-SEM volume in the 3D mask editor with its mitochondria masks loaded for correction. Corrections are saved in corrected_masks; the published masks stay unchanged.
records.translation: Ouvre le volume FIB-SEM dans l’éditeur de masques 3D avec ses masques de mitochondries chargés pour correction. Les corrections sont enregistrées dans corrected_masks ; les masques publiés restent inchangés.

records.key: spatial_platform
records.source: Which 10x platform wrote spatial_source: auto, xenium, visium_hd (Visium HD bins) or visium (standard spot-based Visium). auto reads it from the files present; set it only when a folder holds more than one layout. Default auto.
records.translation: Quelle plateforme 10x a écrit spatial_source : auto, xenium, visium_hd (bins Visium HD) ou visium (Visium standard basé sur des spots). auto la déduit des fichiers présents ; ne le réglez que lorsqu’un dossier contient plus d’une disposition. Par défaut auto.
